baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence يخرون / للأذقان / يبكون / يزيدهم خشوعا.
baseline_models.mechanism: A destabilized descent reaches a precise bodily contact point, discharges through tears and voice, and feeds back as growing embodied quiet.

activation_trace.role: A disturbed, sounding fall supplies the initiating bodily loss of elevation.
The meeting point of the jaws makes the descent concrete and face-first.
Grief, tears, and voice provide the bodily release between falling and deepening.
Growth turns the sequence into a reinforcing process rather than a static pose.
Lowering, submission, stilled limbs, and quiet voice name the process's embodied result.

changed_reading.before: They fall, cry, and then possess more humility.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a bodily feedback event: descent, contact, and tears actively deepen a quieted, lowered disposition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sounding possibilities of يخرون and يبكون resolve into خشوعا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Turbulent or constricted sound passes through audible weeping and settles into lowered voice; sound is transformed by humility rather than simply erased.

activation_trace.role: A running, turbulent, or constricted sound opens an acoustic trajectory.
Weeping contributes both tears and voiced grief as the trajectory's middle register.
Quiet voice and stilled limbs supply the acoustic and bodily settling point.

changed_reading.before: Crying is an emotional accompaniment to prostration.
changed_reading.after: Crying belongs to an acoustic conversion in which disturbed sound becomes a quieter, more settled mode of response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier increase reignites destructive heat when it subsides, while the focus increase follows falling and tears; the repeated increase operator therefore exposes opposed feedback regimes.

activation_trace.role: A fire's dying down supplies the low point that triggers renewed destructive intensity.
The same growth operation used in the focus drives the earlier punitive feedback loop.
Ignition and blaze identify what the earlier loop amplifies.
Growth now amplifies receptive lowliness rather than fire.
Embodied lowering is the focus loop's opposed output.

structural_cues: 17:97 and 17:109 both attach an increase from ز ي د to a plural object, but the increased states are blaze and humility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated increase construction and the two outputs; I infer a contrast between self-reinforcing resistance and receptivity. A live alternative is ordinary lexical recurrence without a designed contrast.

changed_reading.before: The increase in humility is only a local intensification of feeling.
changed_reading.after: It is the receptive counterpart of an earlier destructive feedback loop: response does not exhaust itself but recursively produces more lowliness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fear in 17:100 closes the hand against outflow, whereas the focus body's lowering releases tears and grows khushu; the context separates receptive humility from fear-driven contraction.

activation_trace.role: Holding wealth back supplies the context's constrictive bodily-economic motion.
Fear mixed with awe motivates that contraction and provides a near-form contrast with khushu.
The outgoing expenditure that is feared marks the blocked release.
Tears and voiced grief provide an actual outflow in the focus.
Embodied submission receives and grows through release rather than gripping shut.

structural_cues: In 17:100 خشية governs imagined withholding; in 17:109 خشوع is increased after falling and crying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent fear, withholding, outflow, tears, and khushu; I infer a contrast of contraction and release. The similar forms may be incidental, so the distinction remains contextual rather than etymological.

changed_reading.before: Khushu is essentially fear made physically intense.
changed_reading.after: The focus distinguishes khushu from constrictive fear: this lowered state permits bodily outflow and becomes more receptive through it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Portioning, patient interval, and repeated descent in 17:106 give the focus increase a temporal mechanism: humility can sediment through measured, successive reception.

activation_trace.role: Distribution into parts supplies successive units rather than a single undivided impact.
Deliberate patience without haste supplies spacing in which response can deepen.
Caused descent and delivery provide repeated incoming material for the process.
Growth names the cumulative result of the measured sequence.

structural_cues: The lead-in places portioning and unhurried delivery before two successive fall-to-chin scenes in 17:107 and 17:109.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divided delivery, waiting, repeated descent, and increase; I infer accumulation across receptions. A live alternative is that يزيدهم describes only the immediate episode.

changed_reading.before: Humility spikes within one overwhelming encounter.
changed_reading.after: Humility accretes through portioned and patiently received encounters, with each embodied response becoming material for the next.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact fall-to-chins pair appears in 17:107 and again in the focus: the first occurrence resolves as prostration, while the second adds tears and increase, turning repetition into a deepening second cycle.

activation_trace.role: The first disturbed fall establishes the repeated bodily movement.
The same jaw meeting-point fixes the first movement at the identical bodily endpoint.
Lowliness in prostration identifies the first fall's ritual-bodily resolution.
The repeated fall restarts the movement after the intervening utterance.
Repeated chin contact confirms recurrence rather than a merely related gesture.
Growth makes the second cycle explicitly cumulative.

structural_cues: 17:107 and 17:109 repeat خ ر ر followed by ذ ق ن; سجدا closes the first, while crying and increase extend the second.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact lexical recurrence with different continuations; I infer iterative deepening rather than redundant restatement. Emphatic parallel description remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports one fall whose emotional consequence is crying.
changed_reading.after: The focus is a second embodied pass: prostration recurs after voiced recognition and now opens into tears and further-growing humility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah rejects both raised proclamation and suppressed speech and seeks a path between them, calibrating the focus's fall-sound, weeping, and quieting as measured audibility.

activation_trace.role: Turbulent or constricted sound supplies one acoustic edge within the focus.
Voiced grief supplies audible response without fixing its volume.
Publicly raised sound marks the upper endpoint that the following instruction refuses.
Lowered secret speech marks the opposite endpoint that is also refused.
A traversable path supplies the regulating middle course for voiced devotion.

structural_cues: Immediately after the focus, 17:110 coordinates لا تجهر, لا تخافت, and ابتغ بين ذلك سبيلا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an acoustic focus and an adjacent volume instruction; I infer that the latter calibrates the former. The command may concern formal prayer alone, so its reach back to crying remains qualified.

changed_reading.before: Greater humility means moving from crying toward silence.
changed_reading.after: Humility regulates rather than abolishes voice: tears may remain audible while devotion avoids both display and suppression.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing ayah rejects dependency born of degradation and commands magnification; this bounds the focus's low posture as chosen proportion before greatness, not coerced human abasement.

activation_trace.role: Voluntary lowering and quieted limbs supply the focus state that needs differentiation.
Breakage under coercion identifies the degrading lowliness negated in the closing claim.
Magnifying something within the breast supplies the positive vertical relation that frames khushu.

structural_cues: After increased خشوع, 17:111 negates a protector arising from ذل and closes with the doubled command to magnify.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies neighboring lowliness terms under opposite grammatical valuations and a final magnification; I infer a semantic boundary between receptive khushu and degrading dhull. They may instead be independent closing themes.

changed_reading.before: Falling to the chin is self-abasement intensified by emotion.
changed_reading.after: The low posture is non-degrading self-placement: bodily height is relinquished as greatness is assigned beyond the self.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it materializes an affective scene as ecology. It remains anchored by the focus branches for tears, growth, and low dormant earth; downstream prose should label it a branch-induced analogy, not claim that the ayah lexically equates tears with irrigation.

activation_trace.role: Flowing tears provide the moisture-like material in the analogy.
Growth supplies the change undergone by the receptive state.
Low, dormant ground turns humility into receptive terrain within the material analogy.

changed_reading.before: Tears display an already present humility.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, tears act like moisture reaching lowered dormant ground, so the displayed response also quickens and grows humility.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a rare load-bearing chin image recasts prostration as support under descended material. It remains anchored in the focus's explicit chin contact and the packet's preceding descent; downstream prose should present it as a bodily load-bearing analogy, not replace the ordinary anatomical sense of chin.

activation_trace.role: Delivered descent supplies the incoming weight in the analogy.
The fall transfers the body downward under that received impact.
A burdened figure using the chin for support makes the contact point a last bodily brace.

changed_reading.before: The chin merely marks how far the worshippers fall.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the chin is the body's last support under what has descended: collapse becomes an extreme way of bearing reception.

strongest_changes: The repeated 17:107 and 17:109 fall-to-chins sequence reads as iterative deepening, not redundant posture.
The focus increase becomes the receptive counterpart of 17:97's self-renewing blaze.
Portioned delivery and the following voice calibration turn humility into cumulative, measured response.
summary.what_was_special: Exact bodily-root recurrence, opposed uses of increase, and branch images spanning sound, terrain, and support let one compact ayah operate as feedback, iteration, and material transformation.
remaining_uncertainties: The opposed increase loops may be lexical recurrence rather than a designed contrast.
The volume instruction in 17:110 may not govern the focus's crying directly.
The ecological and load-bearing readings should remain explicitly exploratory analogies.
